items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: talkin' about Joe DiMaggio & Yogi Berra

ctx.x: What time did things start at the 3 Deuces?

I think we played from 10 to four, 10 to 3:30, something like that. It was late in those days you had to play until 4 o'clock. ... I don't know if the other band started, I forget. I know we used to be playing on the bandstand and be havin' a conversation goin' on about football, baseball. Playing the music we would be talkin' about Joe DiMaggio & Yogi Berra & whatnot. And the music would be playin' goin' and we'd be talkin'. I don't know. How that could come across I don't know. But nothin' went wrong. If…
